FORVIA HELLA is a listed international automotive supplier. As a company of the FORVIA Group, FORVIA HELLA stands for high-performance lighting technology and vehicle electronics and, with the Lifecycle Solutions Business Group, also covers a broad service and product portfolio for the spare parts and workshop business as well as for manufacturers of special vehicles. With currently around 36,500 employees at over 125 locations, the Company is active worldwide and generated adjusted sales of €8.1 billion in fiscal year 2024.
 YOUR TASKS
 Car Access Department with over 60 colleagues in Design and Development, Testing, Hardware and System is ready to support you with guidance and training on the job in complete project development activities from quotation up to end of production. We work in a state of the art laboratory and we will give you the opportunity to develop and apply your technical knowledge and creative thinking in various activities like: defining project architecture based on AUTOSAR standard, design and implement specific applications using C programming language, hardware development and functional testing.
Working on latest technologies like UWB(ultra wide band), Bluetooth and NFC with a highly skilled and collaborative team.
Develop and optimize complex test solutions for new and existing automotive Communication Protocols ( wireless and wired)
Review of System/Software requirements
Test specification creation and automation of test cases
Execution of tests, result analysis and reporting of defects
Test environment creation (e.g. HW/SW Simulations)
Provide technical support to internal teams (e.g. analyze device log and provide analysis results, issue reproduction in lab environment)
Drive innovative ideas for testing to ensure a high level of quality and reduced test time (e.g. increase test automation level)
 Your Qualifications
Relevant working experience minimum 3 years 
Knowledge about communication protocols such as LIN/CAN/Ethernet, SPI, i2C, Bluetooth/BLE, NFC, RFID, Wi-Fi
Security and Cryptography is a plus
Experience with data acquisition/analysis tools (e.g. CANoe, CANape, CANalizer, Oscilloscopes or similar)
Knowledge about electronics and embedded systems
Bachelor of Engineering, in the areas of Computer Science, Electrical, or other relevant fields
Programming skills: C / C++ / Python
Good English level, German / French is a plus
ASTQB/ISTQB Advanced Level certification is a plus
 OUR OFFER
Be part of our team: Open feedback culture and plenty of room for innovative ideas and design options motivate you to take responsibility and organize yourself. 
 Be part of our spirit: Colleagues who are true to their job and experts in their field are at your side with advice and action.
Be part of our direction: You will be integrated into your new tasks and will receive all the necessary product and individual training. We train you individually according to your skills and knowledge in order to promote your personal and professional development.
Be part of our balanced work-life: Look forward to flexible and mobile work. You'll get extra vacation days according to your tenure.
Be part of our neighborhood: We convince with a modern workplace and a top location
 Even if you do not meet all our requirements, do not hesitate to apply to us, because the further development of our employees is very important to us and opens up a wide range of opportunities for you in our company.
FORVIA HELLA stands for the variety of all employees. Inclusion and diversity are firmly anchored in our company culture. We are continuously looking for new team players and welcome applications from all interested parties, regardless of their ethical and social background, age, religion, gender, disability, sexual orientation or identity.
Please send us your application via our career portal, stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, with the reference number req18405.
